# Horizon Interpreters
## About
Horizon Interpreters is a UK-based professional interpreting service providing telephone, video, and face-to-face interpreting for solicitors, legal firms, housing associations, councils, and businesses across the United Kingdom.

## Services
- Telephone Interpreting: £1.50 per minute
- Video Interpreting: £2.00 per minute
- Face-to-Face Interpreting: £50.00 per hour

## Languages
Over 47 languages supported including Polish, Romanian, Farsi, Arabic, Yoruba, Kinyarwanda, Dutch, and many more.

## Booking
Clients can book interpreters directly through the website at https://horizoninterpreters.uk or by calling +44 7448 220738.
